question: Will Hollie Noveletsky be the Republican Nominee for NH-01?
rules:
This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins the nomination for the Republican Party to contest the NH-01 congressional district seat in the U.S. House of Representatives in the 2026 midterm elections. The Republican primary will take place on September 8, 2026.

If no nominee is announced by November 3, 2026, 11:59PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of official Republican sources, including https://www.rnc.org/.

Any replacement of the nominee before election day will not change the resolution of the market.

evidence.publisher: University of New Hampshire Survey Center
evidence.excerpt: In the Democratic primary in New Hampshire's First Congressional District, Maura Sullivan and Stefany Shaheen are statistically tied, followed by Carleigh Beriont. Hollie Noveletsky and Anthony DiLorenzo are also statistically tied on the Republican side.

Also on the Republican side, veteran, nurse, and business owner Hollie Noveletsky has 28% support, while Portsmouth businessman Anthony DiLorenzo is at 25%. Manchester state Rep. Brian Cole trails at 7%, while 38% remain undecided. DiLorenzo has President Donald Trump’s endorsement and a significant fundraising advantage, but Noveletsky narrowly led him in the UNH survey.

evidence.publisher: Saint Anselm College / New Hampshire Institute of Politics
evidence.excerpt: Anthony DiLorenzo leads Hollie Noveletsky 30%-17% in the Republican primary. These results are from a Saint Anselm College Survey Center poll based on online surveys of 1411 New Hampshire likely voters. Surveys were collected between August 17th and 18th, 2026, from cell phone users randomly drawn from a sample of registered voters reflecting the demographic and partisan characteristics of the voting population.

evidence.publisher: New Hampshire Public Radio, syndicated by Maine Public
evidence.excerpt: Hollie Noveletsky, Anthony DiLorenzo, and Brian Cole, all candidates in the Republican race for the state’s 1st Congressional District, declined. With the candidates largely in line with the Trump administration on issues big and small, they are instead touting their business records, biographies and professional accomplishments.
President Donald Trump is endorsing Anthony DiLorenzo in New Hampshire’s 1st Congressional District race.

The NH-01 GOP primary debate will be held at the New Hampshire Institute of Politics auditorium on Wednesday, August 26 at 6:00 p.m. Rep. Brian Cole, Anthony DiLorenzo and Hollie Noveletsky have all confirmed their participation. The debates will not open to the general public, but they will be broadcast live on Manchester Public TV channel 16 and will stream online as well.

Manchester, NH – Former Manchester Mayor and Former Executive Councilor for District 4, Ted Gatsas, has weighed into the GOP Primary for NH CD-1 with an endorsement for conservative CEO and Army Reserve veteran Hollie Noveletsky. Noveletsky’s campaign has built a durable coalition behind her with almost 90 endorsements ranging from political figures, like Congresswoman Virginia Foxx and NH Senate Majority Leader Regina Birdsell, to leading organizations like Maggie’s List, the Associated Builders and Contractors (ABC) NH/VT Chapter, and the Associated General Contractors of America PAC (AGC PAC).
